cohort.selection: 11 septic and 33 non-septic ICU stays drawn at random (seed 20260815) from hospital B stays of at least 20 hours, each placed at a different point in its own stay so the shift shows a ward rather than a synchronised cohort
cohort.why_enriched: a truthful random draw of this size contains under one septic patient, and a shift where nothing happens demonstrates nothing. Rates measured on this cohort are not the deployment's rates
